questions.prompt: What is the purpose of separating code into modules?
options: To define explicit reusable boundaries for exports and imports.
To share every local variable globally automatically.
To make every import synchronous file I/O.
questions.explanation: ES modules expose selected bindings and make dependencies clearer.

questions.prompt: What helps keep module dependencies understandable?
options: Hide dependencies in string-based eval calls.
Use explicit imports/exports and keep responsibilities cohesive.
Mutate unrelated global variables from every module.
questions.explanation: Explicit module boundaries make dependency relationships easier to reason about and test.

questions.prompt: Where should you verify environment-specific behavior related to Version Ranges and Lockfiles?
options: The official documentation for the browser API or Node.js runtime involved, alongside the ECMAScript reference for language semantics.
Only the output from one computer.
A random post that does not identify the runtime version.
questions.explanation: The specification defines language semantics; host documentation defines environment APIs and compatibility.
